name: Cartographer
lead: Describe an outdoor area, pick among layout sketches, refine if you want, then finish as a flat map or table-ready layers. Early access opens when hosting is live.
detailBody: Cartographer is a web tool, not a Foundry module in v1. Describe forest clearings, shorelines, or ruins in the open. The tool returns layout options, then a finished battle map you can drop into any VTT.
Table-ready layers split ground and canopy so tokens can pass under cover. Early access runs through Patreon; the hosted app handles generation while this page is the public entry.
disclosure: Map images are produced with generative AI. Draft sketches use a fast model; final renders use a higher-quality pass. We disclose this up front so you can decide whether it fits your table.
